fee_notes: Royalty is 12% of Gross Sales or a minimum weekly Royalty Fee (per footnote 1), whichever is greater. Brand Fund Contribution is 2% of Gross Sales or a minimum weekly Brand Fund Contribution (per footnote 2), whichever is greater — minimum weekly amounts not disclosed in extracted text. Technology and Support Fee is $49/month, subject to increase up to a maximum of $500. Accounting/Bookkeeping/Payroll Service Fee currently $0, maximum $349/month. Placed Accounts Fee is 15% of collected Revenue for months 1-12 on assigned national/corporate accounts. Credit Card Processing Fee Reimbursement up to 3.5% of transaction price. Late Charge $150 per occurrence. Interest Charge 18% per annum (or maximum allowed by law). Minimum Local Marketing Spend $500/month until franchisee places and maintains 25 Break Coffee Beverage Machines in territory. NSF Fee $50 per occurrence. Renewal Agreement Fee 10% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Transfer Fee $2,500 plus training costs and legal fees not to exceed $12,500 ($1,500 to add a principal or entity). On-Site Supplemental Training $1,000 per day.

Royalty Fee  12% of Gross Sales or the minimum weekly Royalty Fee described in footnote 1, whichever is greater | As customer payments are received | We will deduct this fee from customer payments we collect through our centralized payment systems, prior to distributing the balance to you. See footnote 1.
Brand Fund Contribution | 2% of Gross Sales or the minimum weekly Brand Fund Contribution described in footnote 2, whichever is greater | As customer payments are received | We will deduct this fee from customer payments we collect through our centralized payment systems, prior to distributing the balance to you. See footnote 2.
Technology and Support Fee | $49, subject to increase. Maximum increase of $500. | Monthly | We will deduct this fee from customer payments we collect through our centralized payment systems, prior to distributing the balance to you.
Accounting, Bookkeeping and/or Payroll Service Fee | Currently $0. Maximum amount we will charge is $349. | Monthly | This fee is payable if we require you to use our designated provider for accounting, bookkeeping and/or payroll services.
Placed Accounts Fee | 15% of collected Revenue for months 1-12 | As incurred | This fee is payable if we assign a national or corporate customer to you for you to service in your Territory. See footnote 3.
Credit Card Processing Fee Reimbursement | Up to 3.5% of the transaction price, subject to increase by card issuers | As incurred | You must reimburse to us for any credit card processing fees we pay on behalf of your customers.
Late Charge | $150 per occurrence | As incurred | If you fail to pay us the Royalty Fee, Technology and Support Fee, Brand Fund Fee or any other fee or sum due to us, or if you fail to submit your Gross Sales or other required report when due, we may charge you a late fee in addition to interest charges explained below.
Interest Charge | 18% per annum from due date, or maximum allowed by law | As incurred | If you fail to pay us any amount when due, we may charge you interest on the unpaid balance until the payment is received.
Minimum Local Marketing Spend | $500 per month | Monthly | You must spend $500 per month on advertising for the Franchised Business in your territory unless and until you place and maintain 25 Break Coffee Beverage Machines in your Territory
Non-Sufficient Funds Fee | $50 per occurrence | As incurred | If your check is returned or an electronic funds transfer from your bank account is denied for insufficient funds, for each occurrence we may charge you a Non-sufficient Funds Fee.
Renewal Agreement Fee | 10% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee | Before signing renewal of franchise agreement | Payable to us. See Item 17.
Transfer Fee | $2,500, plus training costs and our legal fees not to exceed $12,500. To add a principal or entity, the transfer fee is $1,500 | Upon your request for approval of the transfer | Payable to us. See Item 17
